physiscore.title: Physiscore
physiscore.blurb: J-V, EQE, Abs, PL, Raman, FTIR, XRD, SEM and XPS in one program. Device numbers are calculated from the raw curve, not read from the instrument's summary block.

xrd-analyzer.title: XRD Analyzer
xrd-analyzer.blurb: Peak fitting with uncertainties, Scherrer and Williamson-Hall. Leave out the instrument broadening and it answers `NOT_CALCULABLE`.

nmr-analyzer.title: NMR Analyzer
nmr-analyzer.blurb: 1D and 2D spectra from Bruker, ACD/Labs and JCAMP-DX. Python standard library only.

perovskite-opv-solution-calculator.title: Solution Preparation Calculator
perovskite-opv-solution-calculator.blurb: Type in Cs0.05FA0.79MA0.16Pb(I0.83Br0.17)3 and read off what to weigh. Co-authored.

opv-db-based-on-literature.title: OPV-DB
opv-db-based-on-literature.blurb: 38,849 organic PV device records mined from the literature, derived from Qiu's OPV-DB (CC BY 4.0).

SUYA.title: SUYA
SUYA.blurb: Collects sea temperature, salinity and air temperature around Antarctica from NOAA, HYCOM, Argo and others into SQLite and monthly Excel files.

SwingLab.title: SwingLab
SwingLab.blurb: Swing video with Vision pose, an experimental 240 fps launch monitor and a club catalog back to 2000. iPhone, 12 languages.
